purpose: Canonical, independently tracked evidence lifecycle state. Each gate is an explicit boolean with its own provenance and is never inferred from another gate.

stateModel.meaning: Artifact captured and hashed. Says nothing about rights.
A human reviewer classified reuse rights for this exact artifact.
A human reviewer assessed technical applicability and scope.
Specific excerpts are approved for model context in public.source_chunks.
Approved chunks are mapped to a curriculum learning objective.

invariants: No gate may be inferred from another gate. Each requires its own recorded reviewer and timestamp.
rights_cleared requires a real reviewer identity. Never synthesise or auto-promote a reviewer.
chunk_approved is authoritative only in public.source_chunks; this registry is a mirror for audit.
Candidate rights classifications are recorded as candidates and never as decisions.
Presence in staging is never evidence of rights clearance.
